meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让配音和背景音乐不再互相盖住,把音量、淡化与效果调到刚好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频旁白总被背景音乐压住,或需要给多条音轨统一调音。
copy.tagline_en: Balance voiceover against music and shape fades, ducking and effects per track.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover keeps getting buried by the music and you need it fixed.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 能对已放进 HyperFrames 合成的音频做混音:淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道增益/音量、音量与效果参数自动化、旁白让位(ducking)、效果链(EQ、压缩、限制器等),也能用 <hf-audio-group> 总线统管多条轨道。
howto.when: 当你已经放好音频、要给它混音时触发,比如做淡入淡出、调轨道音量或做旁白让位。找 BGM/SFX 或生成配音用 /media-use,片段时点与轨道布局用 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 把这条旁白下面的人声音乐床做 carve,让旁白听得清
say.note: 会在音乐轨写 carve 属性并生成自动化轨。

say.text: 给这条音乐轨加淡入,结尾 2 秒淡出
say.note: 会在该轨生成淡入淡出包络。

say.text: 给这条人声轨加 80Hz highpass,再用限制器压住峰值
say.note: 效果按信号顺序写进 data-fx-chain。

howto.what_en: Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, crossfades, track gain/volume, volume and effect automation, ducking/voiceover carve, effect chains, and one <hf-audio-group> bus for several tracks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio already placed in a composition needs mixing, e.g. fades, track volume, or voiceover carve. Sourcing or generating audio is /media-use; clip timing/layout is /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Carve the music bed under this voiceover so the narration stays clear
say_en.note: Adds carve attrs to the bed; generates automation lanes.

say_en.text: Add a fade-in and a 2-second fade-out to this music track
say_en.note: Creates fade-in/out envelopes on the track.

say_en.text: Put a highpass at 80 Hz on this voice track, then a limiter on the peaks
say_en.note: Effects written in signal order into data-fx-chain.
